eligibility: Nonempty instruction and output; exact full original Gemma chat-template training-EOS tokenization <=500 tokens without truncation and >0 scored completion tokens. No quality/model/loss filtering.

deduplication.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, alphanumeric word tokens joined by single space; strip role wrappers by extracting user text additionally for historical role-labelled prompts.
deduplication.views: Complete rendered prompt for all rows plus standalone instruction for exact grouping.
deduplication.similarity: word unigram+bigram TF-IDF, sublinear_tf=True, norm=l2, min_df=1, no feature cap; fit to unique complete normalized prompts from new source and historical inputs; float64 cosine >=0.85
deduplication.clusters: Connected components across all source rows and all historical prompt vertices; also connect same normalized source instruction even if input differs. Reject any component containing any historical input. Choose one source row per remaining component.
deduplication.history: Reuse the three hashed historical input extracts (89 enumerated input files;20,133 unique normalized prompts), then add all336 prior magnitude rows as forbidden prompt vertices and source IDs. Do not read current model outputs or descriptor artifacts.
deduplication.limits: Lexical/source-record separation from enumerated prior inputs does not guarantee full semantic independence, held-out task families, or absence from model pretraining. Alpaca answers are model-generated and correctness is not asserted.

selection: Seeded shuffle of eligible components sorted by canonical minimum source row index; representative is seeded permutation-first eligible source row in that component; take first336, sequentially partition first256 into32 batches of8, next16 calibration, last64 evaluation. Stop with explicit failure if insufficient; do not change thresholds.
